flag.description: The label on the card (Worker voice, Employer voice, …). Pick one, or use "Create a relation" to add a new label.

photoCaption.description: One short line under the photo saying what or who it shows, or why it is here (about 140 characters at most). Not the photographer credit: that goes in the credit field and shows as “Photo By:”. Don't repeat the headline. Required to publish when a photo is set.
